bandReport.notes: Items 39-69, contiguous, no gaps, no repeats. Item 39 starts whole ('39.') at the top of p16-c1 and item 69 ends whole at the foot of p26-c2, so neither band edge is cut. All six pages are English. Items continuing across the column gutter: 45 (stem on p18-c1 foot, statements and options at the top of p18-c2), 56 (stem on p22-c1 foot, options at the top of p22-c2), 67 (stem and statements on p26-c1, 'Select the answer...' and options at the top of p26-c2). COLUMN CROPS: the automatic split is clean; c2 crops carry a sliver of word-endings from the left column at their left edge (e.g. p20-c2), which belong to c1 and were ignored. No crop worked around. FIDELITY: the booklet prints decimals with a raised dot (40·5, 17·5, 8·6%, 153·33); recorded as ordinary decimal points. Item 63 prints 'at least cricket and football' etc., transcribed as printed. Item 67 options print '3 and 4' / '1 and 2' without 'only', as printed; 'favor' is the booklet's spelling. Item 66 prints '4th – 7th century AD'. Item 68 text titles are italic in print, recorded as plain text. No figure items. CLASSIFICATION judgement calls: 39 (Black Tigers, Similipal) under Environment and Ecology / National Parks and Wildlife Sanctuaries; 40 (Singareni Collieries) under Economy / Energy and Power Sector; 45 (South Coast of Australia climate) under Geography / Global Climate Zones; 50 and 61 (ages) under General Mental Ability / Age Problems; 63 (three-sport class counts) under Venn Diagrams and Set Logic / Set-Based Counting; 66 (4th-7th century costume) under Ancient India / Gupta Empire and Post-Gupta Period; 68 (texts and subjects) under Art and Culture / Literature.
